title: Archive legacy _bmad-output/ reports per the CLAUDE.md output-path policy

evidence.quote: 30 legacy refactor-wave outputs still live in _bmad-output/

why: Root CLAUDE.md states BMAD outputs now write into docs/, not _bmad-output/. The 30 files there are point-in-time wave logs that predate the policy; leaving them at a top-level path agents scan invites them to be read as current guidance.
recommendation: Move _bmad-output/** into docs/_archive/ (they are historical logs) and delete the directory.
acceptance_criteria: _bmad-output/ no longer exists in git; files live under docs/_archive/ with a README pointer

corrections: sites should read 29 files (+1 subdirectory) rather than 30 files; trivial miscount, doesn't affect the finding's validity.
